task83_root_cause: launch: focus check polled only 0.3 s after one SetForeground request; Notepad came to the front later (next observation showed it in front) - the launch was reported as an error although it succeeded

type (approval 38): the approval was answered while another window ('◑ Bossman версия 1.0 аудит и финализация' = Windows Terminal, windowsterminal.exe) was in front; the handler correctly refused input because the foreground changed - the old contract bound input to 'whatever is in front', not to a window
focus_window (approval 39): the model sent no generation; the handler answered 'observation generation=None is no longer valid (restart/STOP/unknown outcome)' - a misleading reason

focus_window by title 'Блокнот' (approval 40) was rejected by the operator: the title matched the owner's unrelated Notepad windows; Win11 Notepad keeps ALL its windows (incl. private documents) in one notepad.exe process, so process identity alone cannot separate them
what_changed: owner-only per-task app grant from a code-reviewed catalog (notepad, calculator, charmap, paint); shells, terminals, browsers, messengers, password managers, UAC, credential UI, Windows Security, Explorer and Bossman can never be granted or targeted
with a grant: input, focus_window and targeted observe reach only windows launched by that task; other windows are observed without elements

observations carry [hwnd, pid]; approved input/focus_window must carry generation+window+pid (in the approval digest); the effect re-reads that hwnd and refuses on changed pid/title/tabs/content or when not in front; the server never restores focus itself; focus_window = one plain request, refusal final
type refused unless the OS keyboard focus is in an Edit/Document of the bound process (cfc922e4)
secret-like text and irreversible external actions refused with or without approval
missing generation now reported as such
limitations: Approving in a window on the same desktop (dashboard, terminal) moves the foreground and refuses the pending input by design; this run approved through the CLI API (no window focus). Approve from the Telegram Pult/phone/CLI for desktop typing.
Only one model, one app (Notepad), one empty window, two runs; not a reliability measurement.
Owner decisions were scripted by the harness (approve only on-target steps), not clicked by the owner.
Text went through clipboard + Ctrl+V because the keyboard layout was Russian; per-key typing was not exercised in run 2.
Calculator/charmap/paint under a task grant are covered by unit tests only, not live.
Task-level status stays 'failed' (action_contract/no_verified_action, threat model R10).
The model's final report in run 1 omitted its own failed first type attempt.
Win32 SetForegroundWindow may be refused by Windows foreground lock while the owner is typing elsewhere; then focus_window fails honestly.
Installed :8801 build (6de18f8d) does not contain this change until it is promoted.
